study.assay: construct-level DNA/RNA/protein measurements for synonymous N-terminal variants

eligibility.reason: This E0 artifact establishes source integrity, schema, descriptive QC and grouping requirements only. The official report contains 280 distinct Promoter.seq+RBS.seq leader contexts. Only leader-context-limited N-terminal construct function is supported; full-length CDS and native-UTR claims are unsupported, and a multi-gene pool is not protein OOD evidence.

format.row_width: exactly 75 fields for every header and data row

construction.supported_scope: leader-context-limited N-terminal CDS window construct function only
construction.leader_sequence_definition: Promoter.seq concatenated directly with RBS.seq as an operational construct key; this is not a native UTR annotation

cleaning.normalization: CSV parsing and serialization only: UTF-8, comma delimiter and LF line endings

qc.genetic_code: standard genetic code; ATG start and TAA/TAG/TGA stops
qc.duplicate_policy: report Name, exact CDS and (Name, CDS) duplicates without removing rows

outputs.clean_csv_columns: all 75 original columns in original order
outputs.clean_csv_rows: all 14,234 raw data rows for the frozen official input

limitations: Candidate-study E0 provenance and QC only; this is not a final untouched dataset designation.

Only function within the observed promoter/RBS/leader-context and N-terminal-window construct geometry is supported; 280 leader contexts are not a unified fixed leader, and full-length CDS, native UTR and protein OOD claims are not supported.
A pool containing multiple Gene labels must not be relabeled as protein OOD or used to claim full-length protein generalization.
Filter, insufficiency and range flags are descriptive only in E0; no low-expression, failed or flagged variant is removed.
Duplicate names and sequences are reported and must be blocked from split leakage, not silently collapsed.
Numeric summaries exclude missing, non-numeric and non-finite entries and do not impute or repair source values.
License and redistribution rights remain unconfirmed and require separate review.
No functional conclusion, scientific positive claim, model training, calibration, selection or benchmark conclusion is authorized by this E0 artifact.
